description: Download the media of specific Telegram messages given their t.me links (e.g. https://t.me/channel/123) and return the absolute paths of newly downloaded files. Use when you already have message links rather than a chat to scan. Already-present files are skipped (--skip-same).

extensions.description: Comma-separated file extensions to include, e.g. 'xlsx,pdf'

urls.description: Telegram message links; each must start with https://t.me/

name: tg_download_url
title: Download Telegram media by t.me link
